primary: V7 framing and logical-prefix SHA256 are serialized on the packer before DATA submission.
interpretation: The v7 packer stage is almost entirely CPU rather than blocked I/O in the solo trace; framing and prefix hashing account for about97percent of that stage CPU. The caller also has additional canonical preparation and owned PITR-entry work. Component timings are nested where indicated and must not be summed across overlapping threads/calls.
not_proven: The diagnostic v4/v7 captures have different long-I/O conditions. Their raw throughput is excluded, and the measured CPU components do not assign an exact fraction of the scored17percent gap. No inherent uniform v7 slowdown, missing SHA acceleration, or extent-initialization fix is established.
next_targets: Reduce additional PITR entry allocation/copying and canonical preparation.
Reduce frame construction/zeroing/checksum work while preserving byte-exact output.

Examine whether prefix hashing can overlap DATA I/O with an explicit hash-ready durability dependency; past overlap trials did not qualify, so this is an investigation target, not a new recommendation to repeat them unchanged.
